title: Minoxidil and Finasteride for Hair Loss: How They Work, Results and Side Effects
seo_title: Minoxidil & Finasteride: Results & Side Effects | FullyVital
seo_description: How minoxidil and finasteride work for hair loss, how well they work, side effects, using them together, oral minoxidil, and options for women.
summary_html: How minoxidil and finasteride work for hair loss, results, side effects, using them together, and options for women.
notes: Rebuilds the 2023 /minoxidil page (598 impressions) as an informational hub for the drug cluster. Targets 'finasteride and minoxidil' (27,100 a month, KD 6), 'alopecia finasteride' (60,500), 'minoxidil pills' (18,100, KD 4), 'spironolactone and hair loss' (12,100, KD 4) and 'minoxidil before after' (8,100, KD 0). The 450,000-a-month 'minoxidil' head term is commercial and won by brands and pharmacies.

Medical and balanced: how each drug works, results, side effects (table plus a 2016 systematic review), combination use, and women's options. It says plainly that FullyVital is drug-free and not a substitute.
FAQ built from Google's 'People also ask' for 'finasteride and minoxidil' and 'minoxidil for thinning hair'. Celebrity questions (Trump, Jennifer Lopez) were skipped.
3 studies: a 2022 JAMA Dermatology network meta-analysis, a 2021 oral minoxidil review and a 2016 systematic review of finasteride/dutasteride side effects.

After publishing: /finasteride-before-and-after merges into /finasteride-results-timeline (both got about 10,000 impressions and almost no clicks, splitting one search). Removed pages redirect: /spironolactone-for-hair-loss (8,264 impressions), /dutasteride, /rogaine, /rogaine-or-fully-vital → this hub; /finasteride-results → /finasteride-results-timeline; /propecia → /finasteride; /ketoconazole → /thinning-hair-shampoo; /laser-hair-therapy → /low-level-laser-therapy.
